adjudication.depicted_input: Left-side training schematic showing a transcriptome embedding paired with a natural-language question and fed into the LLM via the depicted embedding pathway.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible because it contains the model-facing transcriptome embedding and question prompt, but it extends unnecessarily into perplexity-based evaluation. The same source figure contains a cleaner region: the left schematic alone. That region directly depicts the fine-tuning inputs for Mistral 7B, namely transcriptome-derived embeddings and prepared questions. It does not support the inference-only routes about cluster-averaged embeddings or hidden top-gene initiation.
